What is the historical significance of Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood?

**Why Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood matters**  

• Built in the **1890s**, it’s one of Dubai’s oldest residential districts. (From Excerpt 1)  
• Originally housed **about 60 homes** arranged along narrow, winding lanes, showing the traditional layout of the time. (From Excerpt 1)  
• Founded mainly by **affluent Persian merchants** who came for Dubai’s booming trade and the incentives the Emirati offered, highlighting the city’s early international commercial ties. (From Excerpt 1)  
• Today it stands as a **living snapshot** of that era’s architecture and community life, preserving the cultural blend of Persian influence and Emirati heritage. (Inferred from the historical details in Excerpt 1)
